summary: Frontend-only testing of 4 new features: splash screen, onboarding wizard, login screen, and CredEasyLogo component. All core flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: isLockEnabled defaults to true (val !== 'false'), which causes AppLockScreen to appear immediately after first onboarding completion since lockEnabled was never explicitly set to false. New users see a PIN lock screen before ever setting a PIN — the default PIN is '1234'. Consider defaulting lock to false for new users (only enable after they explicitly set it).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash → Onboarding → Dashboard flow is fully working. AsyncStorage persists setup_done flag correctly in web. AppLockScreen appears after first setup due to lock defaulting to true. All testIDs (onboarding-get-started, onboarding-biz-name, onboarding-phone, onboarding-business-next, onboarding-google-signin, onboarding-finish, login-google-btn, login-skip-btn) are present and functional.
